task_instance: Prepare a production launch of a small 'taskSharing' feature: implement it behind a feature flag with an owner/expiration and canary rollout percentage, add a health-check and metrics endpoint, write unit tests covering both flag states, run tests/lint/dependency-audit as the pre-launch code-quality/security checks, start the service locally and verify health/metrics/feature-flag responses, run a rollback dry run (disable the flag, confirm behavior, restore it, confirm health), and produce a filled-in pre-launch checklist and rollback plan document.
evidence: Built a minimal Node HTTP service in the work directory: server.js (health check /health, metrics /metrics, feature-flagged /api/task-sharing, structured error handling), feature-flags.js (owner/expiration/canary rollout %, internal-user override), metrics.js (request/error/latency tracking). Ran `npm test` (node --test): 6/6 tests passed, covering health check, 404 handling, metrics counters, and both feature-flag states (internal user ON, regular/canary user default). Ran `npm run lint` (custom check standing in for eslint): passed, no console.log/TODO. Ran `npm i --package-lock-only && npm audit`: 'found 0 vulnerabilities'. Started the server locally on PORT=8123 (port 3000 was occupied by an unrelated pre-existing process in the sandbox, confirmed via EADDRINUSE in server.log) and verified live: GET /health -> {"status":"ok"}; GET /api/task-sharing?userId=team-1 -> enabled:true (internal override); GET /api/task-sharing?userId=regular-user-42 -> enabled:false (outside 5% canary); GET /nope -> 404; GET /metrics -> real requestCount/errorCount/p50/p95/p99. Ran a canary simulation over 200 synthetic user IDs: ~4% enabled, close to the configured 5% target. Performed a rollback dry run: set rolloutPercent to 0, confirmed regular users stay off and internal team override still works (useful for continued debugging during an incident), restored rolloutPercent to 5, re-verified /health still returns ok. Stopped the server and confirmed the port was released (curl exit code 7, connection refused). Wrote PRELAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md (checked off items actually verified above; left N/A items unchecked with a reason, e.g. no frontend/DB/auth surface in this minimal demo, no public deployment per sandbox rules) and ROLLBACK_PLAN.md (trigger conditions, rollback steps, dry-run evidence, time-to-rollback). No public deployment, no external services, and no credentials were used, consistent with the sandbox's safety rules; the skill's core deliverable (feature-flagged staged rollout with monitoring, a verified pre-launch checklist, and a tested rollback plan) was produced and verified end-to-end locally.
